content: {"reasoning":"The denial is CO-197 for missing prior authorization; the retro-auth window closed at 30 days post-service (now 147 days), so request_retro_auth is not permitted, and this payer offers no peer-to-peer. Resubmitting (clean or corrected) would not cure a missing auth and risks duplicate/process penalties, and an auth failure is provider liability so billing the patient is improper. The only legitimate path to recover the allowed amount is a formal appeal arguing medical necessity for the extended cardiac monitoring, using the documentation on hand while ~33 days of timely filing remain.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
